decisions.reason: Weekly reassessment of Cloud Sandboxes. The fetched sandbox page is the local-sandboxing article, so its cloud-specific stage and policy text was not fetched. The billing page confirms the meters and the separate-budget caveat. Prices are per vCPU second, which differs from the catalog's per-compute-second wording. All gates stay unknown; human dates are not renewed.

citations.quote: Cloud sandboxing : Run an entire Copilot session remotely, inside a fully isolated, ephemeral Linux environment hosted by GitHub.
The compute meter tracks the time a cloud sandbox is running, measured in vCPU seconds.
To control cloud sandbox spending, use a product-level or SKU-level budget.
